claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; business retained as going concern; net losses in each full fiscal year 2015-2018 (2018 net loss $(31.7)M on $1,610.6M net sales)
claude.rationale: The slice documents that the company continued operating the same steel product line (500+ grades of carbon/alloy steel) on the same operational and metallurgical basis established at separation, with no reported product/operations incoherence, supporting p4_pathway=0. It reports a stable workforce (~3,000 employees, ~61% under collective bargaining agreements) as a going concern with no documented operations-vs-people/management fracture, and explicitly records any such specific disruption as [UNVERIFIED], supporting p5_pathway=0. This is a post-separation standalone record with no counterparty; the slice provides no evidence about controlling-intent archetype or reconciliation of two business models, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: net loss in each of the four full fiscal years 2015–2018
gemini.rationale: The evidence slice explicitly states that no documented fracture specifically at the product/process interface or at the process/organization interface was located in the fiscal 2018 annual report. The company continued its product line and operations along the same lines established at separation, maintaining its workforce and operating as a going concern.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; net losses each year 2015-2018; assets retained
grok.rationale: The slice states that product line and operations continued along the same lines established at separation, manufacturing the same steel grades with metallurgical and operational continuity, and explicitly records no documented fracture at the product/process interface as [UNVERIFIED]. It likewise records no documented fracture at the process/organization interface beyond generic risk-factor language, with the workforce continuing at ~3,000 employees under collective bargaining agreements and the business retained as a going concern.
